target: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B on clay-direct-dev
question: On the actual clay-direct-dev resource envelope and identical German room audio, does the source-pinned Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B improve the quality/latency/resource frontier enough to challenge Qwen3-ASR and the admitted Whisper baseline?
benchmark_dimensions: exact model artifact hash and runtime/build identity
German WER on identical room-audio corpus
80/160/320/560/1120 ms right-context operating points where supported by the exact runtime
CPU/GPU/RAM and resident-footprint interaction with the whole Frankenstein budget
language-conditioning mode separated from auto-language mode
Q8 baseline kept separate from any later INT4-derived condition

quantization_control.reason: A June 2026 controlled 0.6B cache-aware FastConformer streaming-ASR study reports that 4-bit weight-only encoder quantization at a matched 560 ms tier reduced encoder footprint about 3x with about +0.5 percentage-point average FLEURS WER. That study is architecture-family proxy evidence, not execution evidence for the released Nemotron 3.5 checkpoint.

coordination_gate.next_gate: re-enter the established self-hosted runner/bridge and allow the already queued Qwen3-ASR job to acquire an eligible runner before scheduling this distinct Nemotron runtime benchmark

falsifiers: The exact target artifact cannot be downloaded/hash-verified/loaded on clay-direct-dev.
The Q8 runtime exceeds the resident resource envelope of the whole Frankenstein installation.
Matched German-room WER or partial stability is worse than smaller/current baselines at comparable latency.
Streaming latency or right-context tradeoffs do not beat the existing Qwen3-ASR/Whisper frontier.
A proposed INT4 condition cannot be bound to exact derived bytes and runtime identity.
